babypips-pipsology.author: Babypips
babypips-pipsology.title: School of Pipsology
babypips-pipsology.about: Free beginner course covering forex basics: pairs, pips, lots, leverage, margin, order types and sessions.

taleb-fooled-by-randomness.author: Nassim Nicholas Taleb
taleb-fooled-by-randomness.title: Fooled by Randomness
taleb-fooled-by-randomness.about: How luck is mistaken for skill in markets; survivorship bias; why good results from a small sample can be noise.

douglas-trading-in-the-zone.author: Mark Douglas
douglas-trading-in-the-zone.title: Trading in the Zone
douglas-trading-in-the-zone.about: Trading psychology: thinking in probabilities, accepting risk before entering, and consistency as a mindset. Douglas lists 'five fundamental truths': anything can happen; you don't need to know what will happen next to make money; wins and losses are randomly distributed for any given edge; an edge is only a higher probability of one outcome over another; every moment in the market is unique.

douglas-disciplined-trader.author: Mark Douglas
douglas-disciplined-trader.title: The Disciplined Trader
douglas-disciplined-trader.about: How beliefs and fear shape trading decisions; why traders break their own rules.

kahneman-thinking-fast-slow.author: Daniel Kahneman
kahneman-thinking-fast-slow.title: Thinking, Fast and Slow
kahneman-thinking-fast-slow.about: Cognitive biases: loss aversion, overconfidence, the law of small numbers, hindsight bias.

murphy-technical-analysis.author: John J. Murphy
murphy-technical-analysis.title: Technical Analysis of the Financial Markets
murphy-technical-analysis.about: Reference text on chart analysis: trends, support and resistance, chart patterns, moving averages, oscillators and intermarket analysis.

nison-candlesticks.author: Steve Nison
nison-candlesticks.title: Japanese Candlestick Charting Techniques
nison-candlesticks.about: How candlestick charts are read; common candle patterns and their context.

aronson-ebta.author: David Aronson
aronson-ebta.title: Evidence-Based Technical Analysis
aronson-ebta.about: Applying the scientific method and statistical inference to trading rules; data-mining bias; why rules must be objective and tested out of sample.

schwager-market-wizards.author: Jack D. Schwager
schwager-market-wizards.title: Market Wizards
schwager-market-wizards.about: Interviews with successful futures, currency and stock traders; recurring themes of risk control, discipline and individual methods.

schwager-new-market-wizards.author: Jack D. Schwager
schwager-new-market-wizards.title: The New Market Wizards
schwager-new-market-wizards.about: Further trader interviews; emphasis on money management and matching a method to one's personality.

lefevre-reminiscences.author: Edwin Lefèvre
lefevre-reminiscences.title: Reminiscences of a Stock Operator
lefevre-reminiscences.about: Fictionalised memoir of speculator Jesse Livermore: patience, sitting through trends, and the cost of acting on tips and emotion. Public domain in the US.

esma-cfd-restrictions-2018.author: European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA)
esma-cfd-restrictions-2018.title: ESMA agrees to prohibit binary options and restrict CFDs to protect retail investors
esma-cfd-restrictions-2018.about: EU regulator's 2018 measures on contracts for difference, including leverage limits, margin close-out, negative balance protection and standard risk warnings.
facts: 74–89% of retail CFD accounts typically lose money on their investments, according to ESMA's 2018 review.
ESMA's 2018 measures limited leverage for retail CFD clients to between 30:1 and 2:1: 30:1 for major currency pairs and 20:1 for non-major currency pairs, gold and major indices.
ESMA's 2018 measures required providers to close out a retail client's positions when margin falls to 50% of the minimum required (margin close-out).
ESMA's 2018 measures required negative balance protection on a per-account basis, so a retail client cannot lose more than the money in the account.

chague-day-trading-2019.author: Fernando Chague, Rodrigo De-Losso and Bruno Giovannetti
chague-day-trading-2019.title: Day Trading for a Living?
chague-day-trading-2019.about: Study of all individuals who began day trading Brazilian equity futures between 2013 and 2015.
facts: Of the individuals who persisted in day trading for more than 300 days, 97% lost money.
The study found no evidence that day traders learn by trading.

bis-triennial-2022.author: Bank for International Settlements (BIS)
bis-triennial-2022.title: Triennial Central Bank Survey of Foreign Exchange and OTC Derivatives Markets, 2022
bis-triennial-2022.about: The most comprehensive survey of the size and structure of the foreign exchange market, run every three years.
facts: Trading in over-the-counter foreign exchange markets averaged $7.5 trillion per day in April 2022.

fed-monetary-policy.author: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
fed-monetary-policy.title: Monetary policy
fed-monetary-policy.about: How the US central bank sets interest rates; FOMC statements and meeting calendar.

ecb-monetary-policy.author: European Central Bank
ecb-monetary-policy.title: Monetary policy
ecb-monetary-policy.about: How the euro area's central bank sets interest rates; decisions and explainers.

boe-monetary-policy.author: Bank of England
boe-monetary-policy.title: Monetary policy
boe-monetary-policy.about: How the UK's central bank sets interest rates; Monetary Policy Committee decisions.

cbn-monetary-policy.author: Central Bank of Nigeria
cbn-monetary-policy.title: Monetary policy
cbn-monetary-policy.about: Nigeria's central bank: Monetary Policy Committee communiqués and the policy rate.

bis-triennial-2025.author: Bank for International Settlements (BIS)
bis-triennial-2025.title: Triennial Central Bank Survey of Foreign Exchange and OTC Derivatives Markets, 2025
bis-triennial-2025.about: The latest three-yearly survey of the size and structure of the foreign exchange market.
facts: Global FX trading averaged $9.6 trillion per day in April 2025.
The US dollar was on one side of 89% of all FX trades in April 2025.

elder-trading-for-a-living.author: Alexander Elder
elder-trading-for-a-living.title: Trading for a Living
elder-trading-for-a-living.about: Trading psychology, technical analysis and risk management; introduces the 'triple screen' method of reading several timeframes, and money-management rules that limit risk per trade.

steenbarger-daily-trading-coach.author: Brett N. Steenbarger
steenbarger-daily-trading-coach.title: The Daily Trading Coach
steenbarger-daily-trading-coach.about: A trading psychologist's lessons on self-coaching: journaling, routines, reviewing performance and changing habits.

edwards-magee-stock-trends.author: Robert D. Edwards and John Magee
edwards-magee-stock-trends.title: Technical Analysis of Stock Trends
edwards-magee-stock-trends.about: Classic text on trends, support and resistance and chart patterns.

wilder-new-concepts.author: J. Welles Wilder Jr.
wilder-new-concepts.title: New Concepts in Technical Trading Systems
wilder-new-concepts.about: Original description of indicators including the Relative Strength Index (RSI, which Wilder set to 14 periods by default), Average True Range (ATR), Parabolic SAR and the Directional Movement Index (ADX).

kahneman-tversky-prospect-theory.author: Daniel Kahneman and Amos Tversky
kahneman-tversky-prospect-theory.title: Prospect Theory: An Analysis of Decision under Risk
kahneman-tversky-prospect-theory.about: People weigh losses more heavily than equal gains (loss aversion) and tend to take more risk to avoid a sure loss than to secure a gain.

barber-odean-trading-hazardous.author: Brad M. Barber and Terrance Odean
barber-odean-trading-hazardous.title: Trading Is Hazardous to Your Wealth: The Common Stock Investment Performance of Individual Investors
barber-odean-trading-hazardous.about: Study of tens of thousands of US brokerage households: those who traded most actively earned lower net returns, with overconfidence and trading costs as explanations.
facts: Of 66,465 US brokerage households studied from 1991 to 1996, those that traded most earned 11.4% a year, while the market returned 17.9%.

bailey-backtest-overfitting.author: David H. Bailey, Jonathan M. Borwein, Marcos López de Prado and Qiji Jim Zhu
bailey-backtest-overfitting.title: Pseudo-Mathematics and Financial Charlatanism: The Effects of Backtest Overfitting on Out-of-Sample Performance
bailey-backtest-overfitting.about: Shows how trying many strategy variations on the same data makes an impressive backtest likely by chance, and why such results tend to fail out of sample.

harvey-liu-backtesting.author: Campbell R. Harvey and Yan Liu
harvey-liu-backtesting.title: Backtesting
harvey-liu-backtesting.about: Argues that backtested results should be discounted (haircut) to account for the number of strategies tried, i.e. multiple testing.

fca-scams.author: Financial Conduct Authority (FCA)
fca-scams.title: Protect yourself from scams
fca-scams.about: UK regulator's guidance on spotting investment scams, checking whether a firm is authorised, and the warning list of unauthorised firms.

cftc-learn-and-protect.author: US Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC)
cftc-learn-and-protect.title: Learn and protect
cftc-learn-and-protect.about: US derivatives regulator's fraud advisories, including forex and trading-scheme scams, and how to check registration.

sec-nigeria.author: Securities and Exchange Commission, Nigeria
sec-nigeria.title: Securities and Exchange Commission Nigeria
sec-nigeria.about: Nigeria's capital market regulator; publishes registered operators and warnings about unregistered investment platforms.

businessday-sec-warning.author: BusinessDay
businessday-sec-warning.title: Nigeria's SEC warns on proliferation of unregistered online platforms
businessday-sec-warning.about: News report of the Nigerian SEC warning the public about unregistered online investment platforms.

investor-gov-forex.author: US Securities and Exchange Commission, Investor.gov
investor-gov-forex.title: Forex trading
investor-gov-forex.about: US investor-education explainer on forex trading, its risks and common frauds.

fca-ps19-18.author: Financial Conduct Authority (FCA)
fca-ps19-18.title: PS19/18: Restricting contract for difference products sold to retail clients
fca-ps19-18.about: The UK regulator's permanent rules for CFDs sold to retail clients: leverage limits, margin close-out, negative balance protection, no inducements and standard risk warnings.
facts: Since August 2019, UK rules limit retail CFD leverage to between 30:1 and 2:1 depending on the underlying, with 30:1 for major currency pairs.
UK rules require firms to close out a retail client's positions when their funds fall to 50% of the margin needed to keep them open.
UK rules require that a retail client cannot lose more than the total funds in their CFD account.

boe-uk-fx-survey-2025.author: Bank of England
boe-uk-fx-survey-2025.title: BIS Triennial Survey 2025: summary of UK results
boe-uk-fx-survey-2025.about: The UK's share of the global foreign exchange market in the 2025 survey.
facts: The UK remained the largest centre of foreign exchange trading in April 2025, with 37.8% of global turnover.

cftc-2010-retail-forex-rules.author: US Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC), reprinted by Hedge Fund Law Blog
cftc-2010-retail-forex-rules.title: CFTC releases final retail forex rules
cftc-2010-retail-forex-rules.about: The US rules for retail forex brokers that took effect in October 2010, including leverage limits set through the NFA.
facts: US rules that took effect in October 2010 limit retail forex leverage to 50:1 on major currency pairs and 20:1 on other pairs.

snb-2015-jordan.author: Thomas Jordan, Swiss National Bank (published by the BIS)
snb-2015-jordan.title: The rationale for discontinuing the minimum exchange rate and lowering interest rates
snb-2015-jordan.about: The Swiss National Bank chairman's explanation of the January 2015 decision to end the franc's minimum exchange rate against the euro.
facts: On 15 January 2015 the Swiss National Bank discontinued its minimum exchange rate of 1.20 Swiss francs per euro and lowered its deposit rate to −0.75%.

cnbc-fxcm-2015.author: CNBC
cnbc-fxcm-2015.title: FXCM to forgive most clients for negative balances on Swiss franc move
cnbc-fxcm-2015.about: Report on retail broker FXCM's losses after the Swiss franc move, when many client accounts fell below zero.
facts: After the Swiss franc move in January 2015, FXCM's clients owed it more than $225 million in negative balances.

cftc-my-forex-funds-2023.author: US Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC)
cftc-my-forex-funds-2023.title: CFTC charges 'My Forex Funds' with fraudulently taking over $300 million from customers hoping to become professional traders
cftc-my-forex-funds-2023.about: Press release (8771-23) announcing the CFTC complaint against a large prop trading firm and the freeze of its assets.
facts: In September 2023 the CFTC charged the prop firm My Forex Funds with fraudulently taking over $300 million from customers, and a court froze its assets.

willkie-my-forex-funds-2025.author: Willkie Farr & Gallagher
willkie-my-forex-funds-2025.title: New Jersey federal judge dismisses forex case with prejudice and awards attorney fees
willkie-my-forex-funds-2025.about: Law firm summary of the May 2025 dismissal of the CFTC's case against My Forex Funds' parent company.
facts: In May 2025 a US federal judge dismissed the CFTC's case against My Forex Funds' parent with prejudice and sanctioned the CFTC after finding it had made false representations to the court.

fed-fomc-faq.author: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
fed-fomc-faq.title: What is the FOMC and when does it meet?
fed-fomc-faq.about: The Federal Reserve's committee that sets US interest rate policy, and its meeting schedule.
facts: The Federal Open Market Committee holds eight regularly scheduled meetings a year.

boe-mpc-schedule-2016.author: Bank of England
boe-mpc-schedule-2016.title: Monetary Policy Committee announcement dates for 2017 and 2018
boe-mpc-schedule-2016.about: The Bank of England's change from monthly rate meetings to eight a year.
facts: From 2017 the Bank of England's Monetary Policy Committee meets eight times a year instead of monthly.

cbn-mpc-november-2025.author: Central Bank of Nigeria
cbn-mpc-november-2025.title: Monetary Policy Committee Communiqué No. 160, November 2025
cbn-mpc-november-2025.about: The CBN Monetary Policy Committee's decision and reasoning at its November 2025 meeting.
facts: At its November 2025 meeting, the CBN's Monetary Policy Committee held the Monetary Policy Rate at 27.0%.

sec-nigeria-isa-2025-forex.author: Financial EDGE
sec-nigeria-isa-2025-forex.title: SEC warns unregistered digital and forex trading platforms now a crime under ISA 2025
sec-nigeria-isa-2025-forex.about: Report of the Nigerian SEC's April 2025 statement on registration of online forex trading platforms under the Investments and Securities Act 2025.
facts: In April 2025 Nigeria's SEC said that operating an online forex trading platform without SEC registration is illegal under the Investments and Securities Act 2025.

tversky-kahneman-small-numbers.author: Amos Tversky and Daniel Kahneman
tversky-kahneman-small-numbers.title: Belief in the Law of Small Numbers
tversky-kahneman-small-numbers.about: People expect small random samples to look like the population they came from, and so read too much into a few results.

bls-employment-situation.author: US Bureau of Labor Statistics
bls-employment-situation.title: The Employment Situation
bls-employment-situation.about: The monthly US jobs report, including nonfarm payrolls and the unemployment rate; usually released on the first Friday of the month at 8:30 a.m. US Eastern time.
